cases.name: string decoder
cases.note: The distinct retained-owner test preserves the pinned literal byte fixtures and complete ordered success/failure assertion stream.

adaptation.rationale: Rust BinaryDataReader owns length-prefix decoding and returns an owned byte vector instead of accepting an explicit length and writable destination pointer.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The C allocation, writable destination pointer, and explicit terminator storage; the exact payload, decoded string, twelve content bytes consumed, and truncated failure remain observable.

cases.name: float decoder
cases.note: The distinct retained-owner test preserves the pinned literal byte fixtures and complete ordered success/failure assertion stream.

adaptation.rationale: Rust returns each float and records safe-reader position or overflow instead of writing through a raw pointer and returning a decode count.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The raw begin/end and output pointers; every literal byte fixture, decoded value, four-byte success count, and truncated zero-count failure remain observable.
